title: Lakshya Spearheads Indian Challenge at China Masters
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler Lakshya Sen leads the charge, alongside a promising women's singles trio, at the BWF China Masters.
summary: Lakshya Sen is set to compete at the China Masters, with attention also on the young women's singles players representing India.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has published the rules governing the upcoming Inter State Team Championships, a key domestic event.
summary: New regulations for the 2026 Inter State Team Championships have been released by BAI, outlining the framework for the national team event.

title: BAI Issues Invitation for Athlete Committee Membership
indian_angle: Indian badminton players are invited to apply for positions on the Athlete Committee, promoting player involvement in decision-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has opened applications for its Athlete Committee, encouraging active players to contribute to the sport's administration.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: A change has been announced for the women's doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: BAI has notified a change in the women's doubles pair for the upcoming selection trials for the BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: A national coaching camp is underway in Guwahati for the Indian U17 and U15 junior teams preparing for the Badminton Asia Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for India's U17 and U15 junior badminton teams ahead of their Asian Championships.

title: Player Eligibility & List for World Junior Championships Final Trials
indian_angle: BAI has released the eligibility criteria and list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the list of eligible players for the final selection trials for the BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
